Name: Compute
SQL:
-- sgl.query(Compute, many)
SELECT Doubled(value) AS twice, doubled(value) AS text_form FROM readings;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:Doubled(value)⟩ AS twice, ⟨c1 aliased:doubled(value)⟩ AS text_form FROM readings;

Name: Shouted

-- sgl.query(Shouted, many)
